extra_quotes: Gold electrodes were fabricated by electron beam lithography and electron beam evaporation, followed by dry transfer of hexagonal boron nitride (h-BN) and graphite onto the BSTS flake.
The transport was measured by standard lock-in amplifiers (SRS SR830).

Unlike the cross-shaped pattern reported in dual-gated TI device46,47, our mapping shows only a single diagonal resistance ridge, indicating that the top and bottom surfaces cannot be independently controlled by dual gates.
